confidence_interval_method.by_system: Resample the ten matched seeds within the named fixed chemistry.
confidence_interval_method.pooling: For each budget, jointly resample the ten matching seed IDs across both fixed chemistries and both arms; mean the two chemistries within each seed before resampling the seed means.
confidence_interval_method.scope: Conditional variability over repeated seeds in two previously examined chemistries, not unseen-chemistry or full-benchmark generalization.

variance_definition: Sample variance uses n-1. Paired differences are formed within identical group/budget/seed before variance/SD. n<2 variance and SD are null.
